evidence_ids: the common per-class conformance suite runs through the adapter over a loopback socket with every assertion unchanged

security_justification.audit_integrity: No peer output becomes an acknowledgment except a well-formed exact acknowledgment the handoff accepts, so the adapter cannot manufacture a delivered state.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: The adapter holds no credential; caller-supplied headers are forwarded only to the configured origin and never followed across a redirect.
security_justification.authority_provenance: The inventory and the adapter are recorded as delegated to Claude under the owner's 2026-09-10 instruction, never as a human owner decision.
security_justification.concurrency: Each exchange is one independent fetch bounded by its own deadline; the adapter keeps no shared state between attempts.
security_justification.confidentiality: Events are sent only to the configured origin, redirects are never followed, and headers are never logged or echoed.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptography is implemented; https origins use the runtime's TLS without configuration by the adapter.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Failures reduce to the closed outcome kinds and the handoff's closed codes; no peer body, header, or error message is returned.
security_justification.external_security_integration: The adapter reaches only the configured origin through the pinned runtime's fetch and adds no dependency.
security_justification.fail_posture: Unsafe origins and unbounded settings fail construction, and every ambiguous peer outcome maps to a failure classification, never to acceptance.
security_justification.lifecycle: The adapter is stateless; each attempt ends at its deadline and oversized responses are cancelled.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Changes are confined to the sdk-node paths listed in owned_paths and the canonical sdk-node capability through the fold.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No field is transformed; the adapter posts the handoff's exact body.
security_justification.resource_retention: Response bodies are read to a bound and discarded after parsing; nothing is retained across attempts.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: The adapter never retries; timeouts and transport failures are reported to the handoff and the bounded retry decides.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The delivery peer is untrusted; the adapter is the boundary that reduces its behaviour to the handoff's closed outcome set.
